verdict.rationale: Salv documents its own rule-driven automation. Transaction-monitoring scenarios let users adjust type, threshold and segments or add custom scenarios that raise alerts. Real-time scenarios return a decision in the API response so the payment can be held. Clearance rules automatically close alerts that meet user-set conditions and keep an audit trail, and alert suppression intervals and webhooks on events like new alerts or risk changes add some reach. However, the triggers and actions are confined to compliance actions (raise, hold, close, suppress) rather than a general rule-to-action builder. Missing for 10: general-purpose configurable actions beyond alert/payment handling, user-defined multi-step workflows chaining events to arbitrary actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
